Docs.summary: Resolves cloud-specific metadata for an Azure cloud, keyed by an authority host (for example login.microsoftonline.com or login.microsoftonline.us).

remarks.para: This is the dependency-injection seam that lets one SDK contribute cloud-specific values that another SDK consumes, without either depending on the other's concrete types. The values are carried as a plain case-insensitive dictionary of strings keyed by the well-known literals in , so new keys can be added without changing this contract or breaking existing consumers.
Implementations should be thread-safe and return quickly, as they may be consulted on the token acquisition hot path. Use for a ready-made mutable implementation.

Docs.summary: Gets the cloud-specific metadata for the cloud that owns .
Docs.returns: A case-insensitive, read-only dictionary of cloud-specific values (keyed by ) for that cloud, or null if the host is unknown to this provider (allowing a caller to fall back to another provider or a default). An empty also resolves to null rather than throwing.
